A collection of  Lae'zel's remarks and voicebarks in various locations or plot scenes throughout the game. In some party combinations, a particular party member (including Custom Origin (Tav)) have the priority to voice their line. In these cases, Lae'zel's line is not used at all, or she utters a responding remark, if there is any.

At some points, the locations remarks are common for all possible party members, including Custom Origin (Tav). These are not included here. However, the responses for them can be unique for Lae'zel and thus are included.

Also, some lines provided for Lae'zel initially (as well as for other party members) have been cut during further development, or may not appear due to basic voicebarks replacing them (for example, on ability checks).

Prologue

Nursery and Surgery

  • (Coming to senses near a Mind Flayer Pod[1]): "What is this ghaik trickery? Where am I?"
    • (Responding remark): "A nautiloid? Could it be?"
  • (Interacted with the nearest pod, 1): "Abomination."
    • (Interacted with the nearest pod, 2): "Damnable pod. I'll see that my captors suffer."
  • (Interacted with any other intact pod in the room, 1): "Chk."
    • (Interacted with any other intact pod in the room, 2): "Time is short. No need to tarry."
    • (Interacted with any other intact pod in the room, 3): "Ghaik pod. Accursed thing."
    • (Interacted with any other intact pod in the room, 4): "Empty - one of ours."
  • (Interacted with any other ruptured pod in the room, 1): "Incinerated. Not everyone was fated to survive."
    • (Interacted with any other ruptured pod in the room, 2): "Incinerated. Better them than me."
    • (Interacted with any other ruptured pod in the room, 3): "Incinerated beyond recognition."
  • (Looked out from the hull breach): "One of the Nine Hells."
  • (Looted a dead Mind Flayer): "Dead. If only I'd slain it myself."
  • (Used the Restoration): "I feel... refreshed."
  • (After the first fight with the Lesser Imps, as a party member): "You prove surprisingly adequate in battle. Now - to the helm."
  • (After the first fight with the Lesser Imps, as a player character): "They're dead, Vlaakith be praised. Now - to the helm."
  • (Saw a dragon on the way to upper deck): "The nautiloid won't withstand these dragon attacks for long. Forward!"
  • (Interacting with the Tentacle Aquarium for the first time): "Brains, for these vile ghaik to feast on."
    • (After the first time): "Yet more brains. A veritable banquet for an illithid."
  • (Interacting with Cerebral Aquarium for the first time): "Folliage - collected for study by ghaik."
  • (After the first time): "Foliage - collected from the many planes for study by ghaik."

Ceremorphosis Chamber

  • (Upon entering the chamber, saw the control panel): "Ghaik machinery. I can make no sense of it."[2]
  • (Trying to read the central sigil,  Arcana failed): "An arcane sigil. What might it mean?"
  • (Trying to read the left sigil, Arcana failed): "A sigil I cannot make sense of."
  • (Trying to read the right sigil, Arcana failed): "Chk. I cannot make this out."
  • (Used 'Unleash' button): "Dead already."
  • (Used 'Aggression' button): "They've turned aggressive. A most powerful machine."
  • (Try to open the Elaborate Reliquary without a key): "A reliquary - requires a key."
    • (Found the Gold Key): "A key. What might it unlock?"
    • (Found the key, already tried to open the chest): "A key. I must see what that reliquary contains."
  • (Found a socket in Shadowheart's pod): "Locked down. It needs whatever fits in that socket."
    • (Found the Eldritch Rune): "This must fit the device near that pod."
    • (Found the Eldritch Rune, hasn't spoken to Shadowheart): "An unusual item. Where does it fit?"
  • (Saw dozens of pods in the Transformation room, as a player character): "Kaincha. I can hardly bear to look."
  • (Saw dozens of pods in the Transformation room, as a party member): "Tsk'va! How many hosts have these ghaik infected?"
  • (Trying to read the button in Transformation room,  Arcana failed): "A mystery, even to me."
  • (Saw the woman in the pod transformed): "Foul ghaik! Transformed by a lever. That must never be our fate."
  • (Sat in one of the chairs surrounding the pod in Transformation room): "Voices..."
    • (Responding remark 1): "I hear nothing of the sort."
    • (Responding remark 2): "The chair. It's connected to the nautiloid's systems - and its ghaik."
    • (Responding remark 3): "Come. It will no good to draw undue attention."
  • (Picked up either Slave Mind or Dark Mind): "A brain. Nourishment for the ghaik."
    • (Picked up the second one of these two): "More mind flayer food."
  • (Urging the player character to move on 1): "To the helm - we must not delay."
  • (Urging the player character to move on 2): "There is no time to tarry."
  • (Urging the player character to move on 3): "Do you wish to die? We cannot linger here."
  • (Urging the player character to move on 4): "We must go to the helm - now."

The Helm

  • (In Multiplayer regime, if another player has entered the Helm, while Lae'zel hasn't yet): "To the helm, before the ship disintegrates!"
  • (On the third turn of the fight in the Helm): "Impact is imminent. I must connect the helm."
  • (On the fifth turn of the fight in the Helm): "No time left. I must reach the helm!"
  • (Mind Flayer turns on the party after killing Commander Zhalk): "The ghaik's turned on us. Get to the transponder!"
  • (Mind Flayer died in the fight with cambions): "The ghaik met its match. If only I'd dealt the killing blow instead."
  • (Mind Flayer and cambions dead, player character reminds themselves of the transponder): "Focus - I need to reach the transponder."

Act One

Ravaged Beach and Roadside Cliffs

  • (Near the docks): "Fresh water. There will be a settlement near."
    • (Responding remark): “Do you intend to vocalise every thought? Or just the most obvious ones?”
  • (Encountering Intellect Devourers in the Nautiloid Wreck): "Ghaik devourers. One strike could prove lethal."
  • (Approaching the dying mind flayer in the Nautiloid Wreck): "Even an injured ghaik is a dangerous one. Do not let your guard down."
  • (Approaching unstable rune - the point of Gale’s recruitment): “That rune looks - unsteady. Something's wrong.”
  • (Saw the corpse of the gith guide): “Losiir is gone. His spirit now swims the Astral Sea.”[3]
  • (Found a broken trap near the road): “Useless.”
    • (Found a broken trap near the road, 2): “Another. A mere hatchling could do finer work.”
    • (Found a broken trap near the road, 3): “Broken. Shoddy work.”
    • (Found a broken trap near the road, 4): “Ugh. Pathetic.”
    • (Found a broken trap near the road, 5): “Broken. Pitiful.”

Overgrown Ruins and the Dank Crypt

  • (Respond to the player’s successfully convincing the looters to flee): “It would have been quicker to kill them.”
  • (Entering the crypt from the Refectory): "Nothing but dust. Perhaps the faithful abandoned their god. Or their god abandoned them."
  • (Looked at Jergal's statue in the crypt,  Religion check):
    • (Successful): "A statue to Jergal, if my lessons were true. The Final Scribe."
    • (Failed): "A monument to a forgotten god. How quaint."
  • (Saw the skeletons): "These scribes were armed, for all the good it did them."
    • (Responding remark): “The bones are intact. Would not scavengers have disturbed them?”
  • (After skeletons have been defeated): “The corpses are better fighters than many who draw breath in this world. Curious.”
    • (Responding remark): “Let us fill our packs and depart. The dead need no trinkets - but we might make use of them.”
  • (Sneaked past enlivened skeletons): “I might have preferred strife to stealth - but I'll not deny the spoils.”
    • (Responding remark): “They have no use for such trinkets. We can make use of them instead.”
  • (Ran away, escaped from the crypt): “Retreat is the coward's way - but I'll not deny our gains.”
  • (Found the Book of Dead Gods): "Locked - as if that were enough to keep me out."
  • (Found a Soul Coin): "Odd. What merchant would accept such a coin?"
  • (Entering the locked part of the crypt): "A crypt. What riches might it contain?"

Emerald Grove and The Hollow

Approaching the Grove:

  • (Heard clash sounds): “Music to githyanki ears.”
  • (After defeating first pack of goblins): Pathetic creatures - made for the sole purpose of slaughtering.
    • (Responding remark 1): “A brazen attack, for such lowly creatures. They must have been seeking something - or someone.”
    • (Responding remark 2): “A horde must have settled nearby. More will come, and more after that.”

Resolving the initial confrontation between Aradin and Zevlor:

  • (Aradin/Zevlor was knocked out by the other one): “These k'chakhi waste our time with idle bickering.”
    • (Responding remark to any of leaders' or player character's punch): “Come, let's interrogate the locals. One might have seen other githyanki.”
  • (Aradin/Zevlor was knocked out by a player character): “Pitiful punch. Is the man made of paper?”
  • (Reaction to Zevlor’s words about more goblins): “So, more goblin vermin could be on their way.”
    • (Responding remark): “Forget the goblins. Come, let's interrogate the locals. One might have seen other githyanki.”

Resolving Sazza's fate:

  • (After Sazza told the party about Priestess Gut): “I doubt this priestess would know about purification. Ignore the goblin's ramblings.”
    • (Responding remark): “Forget this goblin priestess. She will not know about purification.”
  • (Helped Sazza escape from the grove): “The goblin could prove useful. If she causes problems, tear her open.”
    • (Responding remark): “ We have made an ally from an enemy. Quite judicious.”
  • (Let Arka shoot Sazza): “One pest among many, hardly to be missed.”
    • (Responding remark): “If I've one regret, it's that I didn't fire the arrow myself.”

In the Sacred Pool and Inner Sanctum:

  • (If Arabella was killed by Teela during the trial): “The girl was a fool to cross Kagha. No offence is so minor that it should escape judgement.”
    • (Responding remark): “Enough. The child is dead. No need to prolong the matter.”
  • (In Halsin’s chamber, saw dead drow): “A dead drow. The druids' work?”
    • (Responding remark 1): “Forget the drow. This jar contains a parasite.”
    • (Responding remark 2): “And what of this statue? A peculiar collection...”
    • (Responding remark 3): “A peculiar collection. I'm keen to meet its curator.”
  • (Read Halsin’s research on tadpoles): “This 'Halsin' has studied the parasite.”
  • (Read Halsin’s research on tadpoles, knows druid’s missing): “We gain nothing by chasing strangers. Only a githyanki crèche holds our cure.”
    • (Responding remark while discussing Halsin's research): “Forget Halsin. Only a githyanki crèche holds our cure.”
  • (Opened the druids’ library with the magical circlet): “The slab is open. What's it been hiding?”
  • (Saw a magic-imbued glaive in druids’ library, knows the story): “The blade from the druid's notebook. I feel the shadows living within it.”
    • (Haven’t read about the weapon’s story): “This blade is - shadowed. I can feel the darkness living within it.”

Dealing with Nettie:

  • (Nettie locked the party up after they refused to take Wyvern Poison): “She hears of the tadpole, and thinks we can be bound?”
    • (Responding remark): “Only proven allies should know of our condition. Anyone else? Keep your lips sealed.”
  • (Feeling sick after Nettie scratched them with a poisonous thorn): “Urgh - dizziness, nausea. Clear signs of poisoning. This is Nettie's doing.”
    • (Sickness getting worse after LR without cure): “I'm... I'm growing cold. I must find an antidote to this poison, and quick.”
    • (Almost dying after second LR without cure): “The poison's done its work. I'm sorry, my Queen...”
    • (Cured from Nettie’s poison): “The antidote worked - the symptoms have lifted.”
  • (Agreed to take Wyvern poison from Nettie): “Wyvern poison - pah! It'll take more than a nasty drink to finish Lae'zel of Crèche K'liir.”
    • (Responding remark 1): “If we begin to turn, we will die by the blade - not like cowards suckling from a noxious teat.”
    • (Responding remark 2): “Trade it to the nearest quartermaster for a better weapon - it looks like you could use one.”
    • (Responding remark 3): “I prefer steel myself. But I was raised well.”

In the Secluded Cove:

  • (Charmed by a Harpy's song, 1) "I must get closer."
    • (Charmed by a Harpy's song, 2) “I've never heard such music.”
    • (Charmed by a Harpy's song, 3) “Such sweet song...”
    • (Charmed by a Harpy's song, 4) “Unimaginable beauty.”
  • (Broke the Harpy's charm) "What is this? I will have your head, harpy!"

Elsewhere in The Hollow:

  • (Saw the Strange Ox): "Hm? That ox is staring right at me."
  • (Watching at the map in Zevlor’s cave): “If this map is accurate, we are in Elturgard. Baldur's Gate is some ways still.”
    • (Responding remark): “Goblins and gnolls are marked on here. A good opportunity for bloodshed.
  • (Near a guarding statue in the Underground Passage): "Glowing eyes? How outrageously obvious - the totem's a trap."
  • (Found malnourished Torchstalks behind the Makeshift Prison): "That mushroom is… unusual. Not sure I should get too close."
  • (Found dead tiefling children after goblins' attack on the grove): “Younglings or not, the weak must be culled.”
  • (Found the vines all around the grove blocking the entrance): “The vines are inpenetrable.”
    • (Found the vines all around the grove, knows about Rite of Thorns): “Let's not linger - the ritual is complete.”
  • (Tried to attack the vines): “Useless. A silver sword couldn't slice through.”

The Forest and the Owlbear Nest

  • (Dealt with Andrick and Brynna, not knowing about the cult of Absolute): “True Soul. Absolute. What ravings are these?”
    • (Responding remark): “A religion. Or a cult. All influenced by their Absolute.”
  • (Heard about the cult previously from Sazza): “The goblin Sazza spoke of the Absolute too.”
    • (Responding remark): “A religion. Or a cult. All influenced by their Absolute.”
  • (Saw Edowin’s tadpole exerting from his body): “Horrid creature. That one lives inside me is… repulsive.”
    • (Responding remark): “Come - we'll not find purification here.”
  • (Found Exsanguinated Boar): “No blood, no clear wound. Like the boar's life was simply sucked away.”
  • (Healed the Mother Owlbear): “Healed or not, she's a hungry beast. Be cautious.”
  • (Found Mother Owlbear killed by goblins, if the party have spared her earlier): “Goblins have silenced the owl-beast.”
    • (Responding remark): “I'd expect no less of vermin.”
  • (Finding a shrine to Selûne,  Religion check):
    • (Successful): "A shrine to Selûne in a grotto like this?"
    • (Failed): "Look there - a shrine."
  • (Near the magically sealed chest): "Sealed by magic. There's no smashing this open."
    • (Found a prayer,  Investigation check):
    • (Successful): “A prayer, with the same symbol as the chest - divine magic.”
    • (Failed): “A prayer, and a symbol. Hidden for a reason, perhaps.”
    • (Tried to open without disarming magical seal): “Agh! Protective magic.”
    • (Opened the chest by reading the prayer): “The chest's unlocked. Simple magic.”
  • (Picked up the scroll with the Selûnite Rite): "A Selûnite coming-of-age ritual. More arduous than I'd have expected."

Sunlit Wetlands/Putrid Bog

Dealing with Demir and Johl:

  • (Saw Auntie Ethel disappeared after helping her against brothers): “ Gone in a wink. I suspect we've been played for fools.”
    • (Responding remark): “Ethel is dangerous, if the brothers spoke true. Perhaps we should pay a visit.”
  • (Found the brothers dead, haven’t met them): “Not just dead: gutted. Hardly a painless kill.” (also serves as a Responding remark when have met the brothers).
    • (Responding remark): “An expert kill - and a painful one.”
    • (Have encountered them prior, arguing with Ethel): “The brothers, dead. So much for a family reunion.”

At the Druid Sanctuary/Decrepit Sanctuary:

  • (Noticed the knife-damaged tree bark in the Decrepit Sanctuary): “That tree's been marked. Hardly nature's work.”
    • (Saw the damaged bark, knowing about Kagha’s letter): “An odd tree. That note to Kagha mentioned something like this.”
  • (Read Kagha’s recruitment letter from Shadow Druids): “Kagha does not just protect the circle. She means to turn it.”
    • (Responding remark): “A pitiless druid harbours a deep secret? Shocking.”
    • (Read the letter before meeting Kagha): “Shadow Druids? This Kagha could prove an obstacle.”

Elsewhere in the Wetlands/Bog:

  • (Found a sword and a helmet in the middle of the bog X: -3 Y: 277): “A fine enough sword. I presume the swamp has long swallowed its owner.”
  • (Tried to pick a fruit from a Barbed Bulrush, pricked a finger): “Ack - my finger. Those thorns are sharp.”
  • (Found slaughtered campsite on the riverbank): "A bloodbath. Someone - something - made quick work of the place."
    • ( Nature check successful): “Redcaps. The trails in the blood leave no doubt.”
    • (Failed): “Whatever did this, I hope it stayed near. I thirst for battle.”
  • (After defeating Gandrel, stood to Astarion): "A sage's choice - Astarion's skills serve us well."
    • (Responding remark): “If he outlives his usefulness, you can dispose of him as you wish.”
  • (Betrayed Astarion to Gandrel): “I find few things delightful. Your surrender of Astarion is among them.”
    • (Responding remark): “Astarion's as good as dead. I won't waste another thought on him.”

In the Riverside Teahouse/Gnarled Teahouse:

  • (Near the fireplace in hag’s house,  Investigation check):
    • (Successful): “Illusory flames - hiding a passage. Where does it lead?”
    • (Failed): “A warm fire, yet no ghaik head to roast on it. Pity.”
  • (After Ethel hasn’t succeed to extract the tadpole): “The tadpole is tainted? This might explain the unusual course of the infection...”
    • (Responding remark): “The ghaik leave nothing to chance - and neither should we. We stay our course.”
  • (Ethel fled from the house, peaceful encounter): “Gone. Seeking more pawns for her head games, no doubt.”
    • (Ethel fled from the house escaping a combat): “Enough of this. It is time to find the hag and end this game.”
  • (Reached out to Connor’s coffin while the hag is still alive): “Ngh - that stung!”
    • (Tried to touch it second time): “Ugh - it's even stronger now.”

In the Overgrown Tunnel and the Ancient Abode:

  • (Chasing after Ethel through the illusory fireplace): “Where are you? Get out here and let's be done with it.”
  • (Entering Entrance Gallery): “Ghastly place.”
  • (After speaking with Lorin): “Just a hallucination, nothing more.”
    • (Responding remark 1): “Ignore him. A hallucination, nothing more.”
    • (Responding remark 2): “Probably another of the hag's mind games. Nothing more.”
  • (Lorin died after being forced out of his corner): “Dead. Powerful magic at work, surely.”
    • (Responding remark): “Powerful magic at work.”
  • (Put on a Whispering Mask and saw through illusion): “Curious. The illusion's been shattered.”
    • (Failed a  Wisdom save against Ethel’s mask): “Pa'vrylk! Out of my head!”
    • (Freed from Ethel’s masks mind control): “My mind is my own. Finally.”
    • (Other hag’s victims act neutral when wearing a Whispering Mask): “They do not attack. The mask must ward them off.”
  • (Wandered into Ethel’s lair, the hag is not there): “That smell. Death, decay - it's stupendous.”
    • (Responding remark): “Stay ready. We aren't alone here.”
  • (Entered Acrid Workshop): “Bones and blood everywhere. Hallmarks of torture.”
    • (Responding remark): “The hag's leftovers, I presume.”
  • (After Ethel’s set Mayrina’s cage on fire): “The cage won't last long. Nor will the girl.”
  • (After resurrecting Connor Vinderblad): “Mayrina is free - but we paid dearly for it.”
    • (Responding remark): “Let us be mindful in the future, at least. There are few fair bargains.”

Blighted Village

  • (Spotted goblins' ambush upon entering the village): “There, on the rooftops. Fresh blood awaits.”

At the blacksmith's house and cellar:

  • (Picked up Selûnite Necklace in blacksmith’s house): “A symbol of the rising moon - this is a Selûnite necklace.”
  • (Found blacksmith's blueprints): "Weapon designs. The work of a mlar - a smith, as the locals say."
    • (Responding remark): "Simple inkwork, simple design. Hardly the pinnacle of metalcraft."
    • (Found another set of blueprints on the wall near the smithy): “Weapon designs. The blacksmith's work.”
    • (Responding remark, if already knows about adding Sussur Tree Bark): “Simple inkwork, no sussur bark mentioned. Hardly the pinnacle of the craft.”
  • (Added sussur bark to the melting forge, has read blueprints): “This looks suitable. Now, to add a greatsword, sickle, or dagger.”
    • (Hasn’t seen blueprints): “The bark is in place. But what is its purpose?”
    • (If has read apprentice’s journal, but hasn’t seen blueprints): “Master weapons? The blueprints can't be far.”
  • (Found a crumbling wall in the cellar): “Falling apart. Just like the rest of this pathetic realm.”

In the Whispering Depths:

  • (After climbing down the well rope,  Survival check):
    • (Successful): "Giant webs. They'll alert their spinners with a mere touch."
    • (Failed): "Webs everywhere. Which means spiders anywhere."
    • (Touched the web and heard Ettercap's shriek): "We woke something up. And it isn't happy."
  • (Felt air motion from the deeper pit): “Feel that? A breeze. Something's down there.”
    • (Responding remark): “Lead the way.”

In the Apothecary's Cellar:

  • (Upon entering the secret cellar): “A laboratory. What mysteries are lurking here?”
  • (Found the tome): “A book of death magic. Let's see what spirits lurk within.”
  • (If the party knows about Gale’s needs): : “A book of death magic. Gale might put it to good use.”
    • (If the tome was destroyed): “The book may have been useful. What were you thinking?”

The deal with Lump the Enlightened:

  • (Blowing Lump's War Horn, if the ogres are dead): “Useless. The ogres are dead.”
    • (Responding remark): “A waste of time.”
  • (Blowing the horn, while staying at the camp): “No ogres. Surely for the best.”
  • (Blowing the horn, if the ogres are too far away to hear it): “The ogre won't come - I am well out of range.”
  • (Blowing the horn, if the deal with the ogres is done): “The ogres will not come - the bargain is fulfilled.”
    • (Responding remark): “The ogres moved on. The horn is useless.”

Elsewhere in the village:

  • (Found a hopscotch game): “Bah! A children's game. These young should have been sparring - not making merry.”
  • (After killing Grukkoh and Buthir): “I doubt those beasts were expecting… visitors.”
    • (Responding remark): “I'll refrain from detailing my conquests, lest you die of embarrassment.”
  • (Found the Curious Book): “ Wine. A reader with decadent tastes, perhaps.”
    • (Responding remark): “A drunkard with no respect for the written word, more likely.”

Goblin Camp

At the gate and in the outer camp:

  • (After any party member  knocked a rhythm on a War Drum near the outer gate): "Must you make us the centre of attention?"
  • (After any party member smeared worg dung on their face): "Must be fresh. I can smell you from here."
  • (Walking among the celebrating goblins): “How are we to find the druid in this chaos?”
    • (Responding remark): “The longer we are here, the more suspicion we will draw.”
  • (Freed the Owlbear Cub and directed it to the camp): "You've acquired a pet - how charming."
  • (Saw sleeping drunk goblins at the platform above the entrance): “Drunk - but not dead, more's the pity.”
    • (Responding remark): “Shush your mouth. Or were you hoping to wake them?”
  • (Found a loose wall at the upper platform): “That wall's falling apart. A good blow should send it toppling.”
  • (Found Shadowheart's body, knows her): “The woman with the relic - Shadowheart. No signs of struggle that I can see. Curious.”
    • (Does not know her): “The half-elf with the relic. Curious.”
  • (Approaching the camp after having defended the grove, Responding remark): “If they want our heads, best we take theirs first.”

In the Shattered Sanctum:

  • (Noticed a Scrying Eye): “That floating eye keeps watch. Best avoided, or it may spoil the hunt.”
  • (Talked to either Dror Ragzlin or Minthara, and they mentioned “the weapon”): “These cultists seek a weapon. Could they mean the artefact that we carry?”
    • (Responding remark): “If so, they'll hunt us to the far ends of this cursed land.”
  • (Responding remark on player character's comment on receiving "penance" from Abdirak): "A crude execution, at best."
  • (Found a blocked trapdoor in Ragzlin’s throne room): “Blocked. No getting through.”
  • (Killed Minthara): “Dead, more's the pity. My blood had just started to boil.”
  • (Killed Priestess Gut): “Disgusting creature. We did her a favour.”

In Worg Pens:

  • (Halsin died while in bear form and reshaped after death): “That was no bear - that was shapeshifter magic. I need to look at the remains.”
    • (Halsin died, players spoke to him previously): “The druid is dead. Perhaps I can still prise information from his carcass.”
  • (Halsin escaped Worg Pens on his own, the party hasn’t been to grove): “Nothing but corpses. Whatever beast they held, it was vicious.”
    • (the party does not know about Halsin missing): “Their prisoner left a mess. If it was one of those adventurers, they'd go back to the grove.”
    • (the party knows Halsin was missing): “Goblins, torn to ribbons - the druid's work, surely. He'll be back at the grove now.”
    • (the party met him afterwards): “An empty cage and some corpses. Must be where Halsin was kept.”
    • (the party knows only about the adventurers): “Whoever they held captive escaped. One of the adventurers, perhaps.”
  • (Trying to use the tunnel left after drawing out Taeglyn's body): “Still blocked. A little extra force should clear the way.”

While heading to the Underdark:
